title: Interfaces
story: An interface lists behaviour. Any type with those methods fits, with no declaration needed.
goal: Make Circle satisfy Shape, then write TotalArea(shapes []Shape) float64.

tests.label: TotalArea of a rect and a circle

hints: func (c Circle) Area() float64 { return 3 * c.R * c.R }
In TotalArea, call s.Area() on every element and add it up.
socratic: Why does Circle not need to say it implements Shape?
What type is each element of the slice?
What happens if Circle has no Area method?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Interfaces”?
